senses.def: ice resembling a pendent spear, formed by the freezing of dripping water
A drooping, tapering shape of ice.
Old World annual widely naturalized in warm regions having white flowers and fleshy foliage covered with hairs that resemble ice
A plant in the daisy family, Asteraceae, with long, powdery-white leaves (Helichrysum thianschanicum).
Synonym of daikon.
A much smaller cylindrical white radish cultivar of the European radish.
Hung with icicles.
Of, pertaining to, bearing, or resembling icicles.
A synthetic superagonist that produces an extreme sensation of cold, similar to that produced by menthol.
in a cold and icy manner
ex: ‘Mr. Powell finds it easier to take it out of mothers, children and sick people than to take on this vast industry,’ Mr Brown commented icily

senses.def: In the manner of ice; with a cold or chilling effect.
In an uncaring or coolly angry manner.
coldness due to a cold environment
a lack of affection or enthusiasm
ex: a distressing coldness of tone and manner

senses.def: The state or quality of being icy or very cold; frigidity.
the formation of frost or ice on a surface
a flavored sugar topping used to coat and decorate cakes
(ice hockey) the act of shooting the puck from within your own defensive area the length of the rink beyond the opponent's goal
A sweet, often creamy and thick glaze made primarily of sugar, often enriched with ingredients like butter, egg whites, or flavorings, typically used for baked goods.

A minor violation of ice hockey rules, occurring when a player shoots the puck from his/her side of the red line so that it crosses the goal line on the opponent's side. A team playing short-handed is not penalized for this.
The process of forming a layer of ice on a surface.
Conditions conducive to the formation of ice on aircraft surfaces.
ex: The Cessna pilots reported that moderate icing was present between 13,000 and 4,000 feet in the cloud layers.

senses.def: A thing which intensifies the appreciation of something already good, or (ironic) the regretting of something already bad.
ex: We went out for dinner and dancing and the icing on the cake was when my boyfriend proposed to me as we danced.
I was having a really bad day at work, but the icing on the cake was getting soaked by a car passing through a puddle.

senses.def: finely powdered sugar used to make icing
Powdered sugar.
a plastic or metal utensil used for cake and pastry decoration, similar in principle to a pastry bag.
(ice hockey) the act of shooting the puck from within your own defensive area the length of the rink beyond the opponent's goal
Having icing.
Resembling or characteristic of icing.
